title: Ericsson and GUST collaborate to advance AI innovation and develop future technology talent in Kuwait
summary: Ericsson and Gulf University for Science and Technology (GUST) plan to launch a joint research and mentoring program to advance trusted AI for telecommunications The program will explore secure and responsible applications of Large Language Models and multi-agent systems, alongside explainable AI approaches for telecom use cases Ericsson experts, GUST faculty members and student researchers will collaborate to strengthen local AI research capabilities and support the development of future technology talent in Kuwait
body_markdown:
- Ericsson and Gulf University for Science and Technology (GUST) plan to launch a joint research and mentoring program to advance trusted AI for telecommunications
- The program will explore secure and responsible applications of Large Language Models and multi-agent systems, alongside explainable AI approaches for telecom use cases
- Ericsson experts, GUST faculty members and student researchers will collaborate to strengthen local AI research capabilities and support the development of future technology talent in Kuwait
